Description

A rampaging wolf-like monster with four horns jutting from its back. It sometimes breathes fire. - Imban

Defense

AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+2 Dex, +8 natural, -1 size)

hp 76 [108] (9d8+36)

Fort +9, Ref +8, Will +4

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee 2 claws +11 (1d6+5), gore +12 (2d6+5)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Berserk, Berserk Pounce, Fire Breath (20-ft. cone, 4d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 18 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Impale

Statistics

Str 21, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 8

Base Atk +6; CMB +12 (+14 overrun); CMD 24 (26 vs. overrun, 28 vs. trip)

Feats Improved Natural Attack (Gore), Improved Overrun, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Gore)

Skills Perception +14

Ecology

Environment mountains, plains

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure none

description.value: A quadricorn that takes damage in combat goes berserk on its next turn, attacking madly until either it or its opponent is dead. It gains a +2 bonus on melee attack rolls, melee damage rolls, and Will saving throws but takes a -2 penalty to its Armor Class. It also gains 2 temporary hit points per Hit Die, which is 20 temporary hit points for most quadricorns. In addition, the quadricorn gains the pounce ability. The quadricorn cannot end its berserk state voluntarily.

effect: After taking damage, starts next turn. Grant [[2 * @attributes.hd.total]] temporary HP once per entry. Cannot end voluntarily.

description.value: A berserk quadricorn can make a full attack at the end of its charge.

effect: Charge and full attack only while berserk.

description.value: When charging, a quadricorn deals double damage with its gore attack.

effect: On a charge only, double gore damage.

description.value: Pounce while active; 18 temporary HP at 9 HD (prose example assumes 10 HD).
